name: Darcy
summary: At the Lakeshire Inn, Darcy keeps the town's defenders fed and spirits high. She serves drinks and warm meals, with special care for Guard Parker.

sections.title: A Friendly Face at the Inn
sections.body: Darcy keeps the Lakeshire Inn's counter running through long days and nights. Lakeshire's militia come for food and drink while gnolls and Blackrock orcs keep the town under pressure. She also looks after guards posted around town. Travelers carry hot meals and friendly errands to defenders stationed along the borders.

sections.title: Romance on the Guard Post
sections.body: Near Three Corners, Guard Parker patrols the roads, and Darcy makes sure he has lunch. She thinks he works too hard on an empty stomach, so she often sends travelers with a meal for him. Darcy watches Martie Jainrose closely. She believes Martie is jealous and rivals her for Parker's favor, even as they all work to defend Lakeshire.

faq.answer: Darcy works as a human waitress at the Lakeshire Inn in the Redridge Mountains. She prepares food for the town's defenders and asks passing travelers to deliver meals to guards on duty.

faq.q: What is Darcy's relationship with Guard Parker?
faq.answer: Darcy is deeply fond of Guard Parker. She packs him fresh lunches and sends them with travelers while he patrols the roads near Three Corners.

faq.q: Why is Darcy suspicious of Martie Jainrose?
faq.answer: Darcy thinks Martie Jainrose is jealous and sees her as a romantic rival for Guard Parker's attention.
You can find Darcy serving patrons at the Lakeshire Inn in Lakeshire, by Lake Everstill's northern shore in Redridge.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you find Darcy among Lakeshire's everyday folk. She keeps spirits high and bellies full while the town waits for aid from Stormwind.
